subject.title: memory_search: chokidar file watcher silently stops delivering events, index goes stale

question: Should memory_search adopt a non-zero default periodic sync fallback for missed watcher events, or should recovery stay watcher-health-only with the default interval still disabled?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but changing the default interval creates background work for existing users and is a compatibility-sensitive config/default decision under repository policy.

options.title: Land compatibility-reviewed interval fallback
options.body: Resolve the linked PR conflicts, keep explicit intervalMinutes: 0 as the opt-out, and require fresh-install plus upgrade proof for the new default.

options.title: Keep default disabled and repair watcher health
options.body: Avoid new default background work, but require a watcher liveness/recovery path that prevents silent stale indexes without relying on user configuration.

recommendation.title: Land compatibility-reviewed interval fallback
recommendation.body: Resolve the linked PR conflicts, keep explicit intervalMinutes: 0 as the opt-out, and require fresh-install plus upgrade proof for the new default.
